title: KV Packet: Recomputation-Free Context-Independent KV Caching for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2604.13226v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) rely heavily on Key-Value (KV) caching to minimize inference latency. However, standard KV caches are context-dependent: reusing a cached document in a new context requires recomputing KV states to account for shifts in attention distribution. Existing solutions such as CacheBlend, EPIC, and SAM-KV mitigate this issue by selectively recomputing a subset of tokens; however, they still incur non-negligible computational overhead (FLOPs) and increased Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) latency. In this paper, we propose KV Packet, a recomputation-free cache reuse framework that treats cached documents as immutable "packets" wrapped in light-weight trainable soft-token adapters, which are trained via self-supervised distillation to bridge context discontinuities. translated_title: KV Packet：面向大语言模型的无重计算、上下文无关KV缓存
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）高度依赖键值缓存来最小化推理延迟。然而，标准的KV缓存是上下文相关的：在新上下文中重用已缓存的文档时，需要重新计算KV状态，以适应注意力分布的变化。现有的解决方案（如CacheBlend、EPIC和SAM-KV）通过选择性地重新计算部分token来缓解这一问题，但它们仍然会带来不可忽略的计算开销（FLOPs）并增加首token生成时间（TTFT）延迟。本文提出了KV Packet，这是一种无需重计算的缓存重用框架，它将缓存的文档视为不可变的“数据包”，并用轻量级、可训练的软token适配器进行封装，这些适配器通过自监督蒸馏训练来弥合上下文的不连续性。在Llama-3.1和Qwen-3上的实验表明，所提出的KV Packet方法实现了近乎为零的FLOPs，并且比基于重计算的方法具有更低的TTFT延迟。
tldr: KV Packet提出了一种无需重计算的KV缓存重用框架，通过将缓存文档封装为带轻量级软token适配器的不可变“数据包”，实现了近乎零的FLOPs计算开销和更低的TTFT延迟。
en_tdlr: KV Packet proposes a recomputation-free KV cache reuse framework that treats cached documents as immutable "packets" wrapped with lightweight trainable soft-token adapters, achieving near-zero FLOPs and lower TTFT latency.
